summary: Open the Ansible Automation Platform route from Networking > Routes, log in as admin with the password from the <instance>-admin-password secret, then apply a subscription manifest or credentials and accept the license.
questions: How do I log in to the platform gateway on OpenShift?
What is the admin password for AAP on OpenShift?
Where is the AAP route in the OpenShift console?

answer_card.title: First login on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Networking > Routes > open the *Ansible Automation Platform* location.
2. Username `admin`; password from Workloads > Secrets > `<instance>-admin-password`.
3. Add a subscription manifest or username/password, pick the subscription, Next through Analytics, accept the license.
